name: Perform Mwas Cyp2C19 Metabolizer Status
description: Perform a Methylome-wide Association Study (MWAS) to identify CpG sites significantly associated with CYP2C19 metabolizer status.
detailed_description: Perform a Methylome-wide Association Study (MWAS) to identify CpG sites significantly associated with CYP2C19 metabolizer status.
when_to_use: When you need perform mwas cyp2c19 metabolizer status analysis

parameters.methylation_data_path: [Required] Path to CSV or TSV file containing DNA methylation beta values. Rows should be samples, columns should be CpG sites. (str)
parameters.metabolizer_status_path: [Required] Path to CSV or TSV file containing CYP2C19 metabolizer status for each sample. Should have a sample ID column and a status column. (str)
parameters.covariates_path: [Optional] Path to CSV or TSV file containing covariates to adjust for in the regression model (e.g., age, sex, smoking status).
parameters.pvalue_threshold: [Optional] P-value threshold for significance after multiple testing correction. (default: 0.05)
parameters.output_file: [Optional] Filename to save significant CpG sites. (default: significant_cpg_sites.csv)
